model.qPlate: phase-only ideal azimuthal shift Delta ell = +/-2q
model.recenterScenario: hard project into shifted p=0 radial mode, then phase-only inverse OAM recenter and p=0 project

reading: q=3/2 is algebraically cleaner for the mod-3 chirality interface because +/-3 is invisible modulo 3, but this same-waist phase-only p=0 surrogate assigns it substantially larger radial-mode capture loss than q=1/2. A physical design therefore needs explicit radial-mode engineering or coherent recentering.
boundary: Analytic LG p=0 overlap surrogate only. No calibrated q=3/2 device, finite-aperture propagation, q-plate retardance profile, radial p>0 coherent recovery, aberration, or measured insertion loss is modeled.
